title: HT Highlighter — Account Brief
description: Synthesized research brief. Every asserted fact lives in signals[] with a source, so the email step can only reuse cited, grounded claims.

is_public.description: true if a CIK/10-K was found on EDGAR

dnc.description: Do-not-contact guardrail. If flag is true, the email step must refuse to draft.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence account brief. Narrative only — no fact here may appear in the email unless it is also a cited signal.

signals.description: Discrete, citable facts/hooks. The email may ONLY reference facts that appear here with a source_url and confidence != low.

source.description: Human-readable origin, e.g. 'EDGAR 10-K Item 1A', 'CRM row: Priya Raman', 'Perplexity news'.

source_url.description: URL when external. null only for internal CRM rows (source names the row instead).

snippet.description: Verbatim supporting text the claim was drawn from. Never paraphrase into the snippet.

gaps.description: What could not be found or was empty, stated plainly. e.g. 'No public 10-K (private company)', 'No prior CRM history'.

recommended_angle.description: Suggested outreach angle, grounded in the signals above. null if grounding is too thin to recommend one.
